primary_task: Extract per-molecule KERMT embeddings (.npy per readout plus metadata) for a user SMILES CSV using a local checkpoint, by running the containerized validate/prepare/extract workflow on one GPU.

requirements.name: docker
requirements.evidence: compatibility: Requires docker, nvidia-container-toolkit, and a CUDA-capable NVIDIA GPU. ... "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/kermt_container.sh" run ...
requirements.basis: lacks: "a Docker daemon (docker, docker compose and container builds cannot run)"; "unavailable_programs": ["docker", ...]

requirements.name: nvidia-container-toolkit
requirements.evidence: compatibility: Requires docker, nvidia-container-toolkit, and a CUDA-capable NVIDIA GPU.
requirements.basis: lacks: "a GPU (no NVIDIA or other accelerator; no CUDA)" and "a Docker daemon (docker, docker compose and container builds cannot run)"

requirements.name: NVIDIA GPU (CUDA 12.6, >= 4 GB VRAM)
requirements.evidence: - **GPUs**: 1 (single-GPU). - **VRAM**: ≥ 4 GB ... - **Driver / CUDA**: any host supporting CUDA 12.6.
requirements.basis: lacks: "a GPU (no NVIDIA or other accelerator; no CUDA)"

requirements.name: KERMT repository checkout ($KERMT_REPO)
requirements.evidence: Export `KERMT_REPO` as the absolute path to the KERMT checkout used for model execution.
requirements.basis: "local_filesystem" grant; the manifest does not say where the KERMT repo is hosted (reachable only if it is on GitHub: "GitHub (github.com, api.github.com, raw.githubusercontent.com) ... are open")

requirements.name: huggingface.co
requirements.evidence: **If omitted**, the skill offers to download the released pretrained hybrid model **nvidia/NV-KERMT-70M-v2**

requirements.name: HF_TOKEN
requirements.evidence: Public models work without credentials; if `HF_TOKEN` is set, the container helper forwards it
requirements.basis: lacks: "accounts, logins, API keys or credentials for external services other than the listed connectors and GitHub (... model hubs ...)"

notes: Reading taken: user supplies a local --ckpt, so the Hugging Face download is optional (hard:false); if the request omits --ckpt, egress:huggingface.co would also be hard and unavailable. Either way the verdict is BLOCKED by Docker and GPU. Unknown: where the KERMT repo checkout comes from.
